items.name: Dissolve
items.description: One picture melts into the next

items.name: Dip to black
items.description: Down to black, then up into the next picture

items.name: Flash to white
items.description: A bright flash covers the change

items.name: Wipe right
items.description: The next picture sweeps in from the left

items.name: Wipe left
items.description: The next picture sweeps in from the right

items.name: Wipe up
items.description: The next picture sweeps up from the bottom

items.name: Wipe down
items.description: The next picture sweeps down from the top

items.name: Push left
items.description: Both pictures slide left together

items.name: Push right
items.description: Both pictures slide right together

items.name: Push up
items.description: Both pictures slide up together

items.name: Push down
items.description: Both pictures slide down together

items.name: Zoom through
items.description: Fly into the first picture and out of the next

items.name: Zoom blur
items.description: A fast radial blur carries the cut

items.name: Circle open
items.description: The next picture opens from the middle in a circle

items.name: Clock wipe
items.description: A sweeping hand reveals the next picture

items.name: Blinds
items.description: Slats turn over to show the next picture

items.name: Pixelize
items.description: Both pictures break into blocks and back

items.name: Glitch
items.description: Colour splits and torn blocks jump to the next picture

items.name: Whip pan
items.description: A fast sideways whip hides the cut

items.name: Spin zoom
items.description: The picture turns and zooms into the next

items.name: Luma fade
items.description: Bright parts of the first picture hold on longest

items.name: Noise dissolve
items.description: The picture breaks up into grain and the next one shows through

items.name: Swirl
items.description: The picture twists round the middle into the next

items.name: Ripple
items.description: Waves run out from the middle and carry the change

items.name: Barn doors
items.description: The next picture opens out from the middle, sideways

items.name: Barn doors up
items.description: The next picture opens out from the middle, up and down

items.name: Wipe diagonal
items.description: The next picture sweeps across the corner

items.name: Wipe diagonal back
items.description: The next picture sweeps across the other corner

items.name: TV off and on
items.description: The picture squeezes to a line, then the next opens from it

items.name: Card flip
items.description: The picture turns over like a card to show the next

items.name: Slide over left
items.description: The next picture slides in over the first from the right

items.name: Slide over right
items.description: The next picture slides in over the first from the left

items.name: Film burn
items.description: A warm burn of light covers the change

items.name: Mosaic reveal
items.description: Tiles of the next picture appear at random

items.name: Stripes
items.description: Stripes of the picture slide away in turn

items.name: Dreamy blur
